 Order

The petitioner's lands in Survey Nos.585/4, 595/5C and 598/2A, situated at Ramalingapuram Village, Samsikapuram Revenue Village, Rajapalayam Taluk, Virudhunagar District, were acquired by the National Highways in the year 2020.
However, the respondents have not provided any compensation to the petitioner for acquisition of the said lands.

Hence, the petitioner is before this T.Kanthasamy vs The Union Of India on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123128575/
